description: Stage 7B.2 hybrid Vector-Graph probe. ONE immutable global algorithm configuration + the decision gates, declared BEFORE the measured run. Contains NO question-specific paths, seeds, answers, or relationship hints, and permits NO per-question tuning. The final per-question evidence budget (top_k) comes ONLY from the frozen Stage 7B.0 question contract, never from here.

modes.V: Frozen authority-aware Vector baseline (Stage 7B.0 result, loaded, never rerun/rescored).
modes.G: Frozen Stage 7B.1 simple Graph baseline (explicit-alias seeds, hop-distance-first chunk ranking).
modes.H0: Reciprocal-Rank-Fusion of the frozen Vector ranking with the frozen simple-Graph ranking.
modes.H1: H0, but the Graph side traverses from EXPANDED seeds (explicit + Vector-chunk + semantic-edge), hop-distance-ranked.
modes.H2: H1, but the Graph side ranks bounded simple PATHS by query<->path-representation semantic similarity (not hop distance).

graph_conditions.real_graph: The exact committed Stage 7B.1 measured graph snapshot (loaded from reports/stage7b1_graph_build_results.json; OpenAI extraction is NOT rerun).
graph_conditions.perfect_graph: The deterministic FakeRelationshipExtractor graph (recall 1.00, precision 1.00, 0 normalization collisions).

decision_gates.note: Exactly one decision is returned. Gates are evaluated in order A, D, B, C and are NOT altered after seeing results. 'target questions' are Q04/Q06/Q07 (deep/distributed chain); 'complete-chain improvement' means real-graph H2 makes complete_chain_represented true where the frozen Vector baseline had it false.

conditions: real-graph H2 improves complete-chain retrieval on at least 2 of Q04/Q06/Q07
real-graph H2 has zero regressions relative to Vector across all other questions
real-graph H2 does not regress Q12
real-graph H2 has zero authority leakage
real-graph H2 uses the same final K as Vector
real-graph H2 uses no query-time LLM
real-graph H2 mean query latency <= 2x the Vector mean

D_keep_vector_graph_navigation.decision: Keep Vector; use Graph only for navigation/offline analysis
conditions: real-graph H2 removes Graph regressions (no regression vs Vector on any question)
real-graph H2 improves fewer than 2 of Q04/Q06/Q07

B_defer_until_reliable_relationships.decision: Defer until reliable structured relationships exist
conditions: perfect-graph H2 meets gate A's improvement/regression/latency/leakage conditions

C_close_graph_exploration.decision: Close Graph exploration for this architecture
conditions: neither real-graph nor perfect-graph hybrid materially improves Vector
